controls.label: Albedo
controls.title: The low-phase PolyCam mosaic is normalized with the ROLO phase function and Lommel–Seeliger disk function. Its 6.25 cm source sampling covers approximately ±55° latitude. The publisher’s 8-bit stretch maps 0.002–0.007 to 1–254. Gray grid marks source NoData, including the polar gaps.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.title: The 5 cm global image basemap retains surface texture and photographed shading. It was normalized to 30° phase and registered to the SPC v28 control shape; small differences from the OLA v20 display mesh remain. This is a separate observed image view; it does not silently fill the albedo view’s missing poles.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows radius minus a 241 m reference sphere, including the body's broad irregular shape. This is not gravitational height or an image observation. Brightness adds cartographic relief from the full source model; Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting. Fine terrain is represented in the map while the displayed silhouette is simplified.
